newsitem.title: UK: Sea Container signs $200 mln securitisation.
newsitem.headline: Sea Container signs $200 mln securitisation.

text.p: Sea Containers has completed a $200 million securitised financing of marine containers, it said in a statement on Tuesday. Sea Containers, which said the move would save it interest costs of around 1.0 percent a year, said it previously relied almost entirely on two revolving credit lines totalling $600 million, of which $300 million is currently drawn.
Some $166.7 million of senior notes issued in connection with the securitisation have an MBIA guarantee and are rated AAA by Standard and Poor's Corp.
The remainder of the notes are subordinated and have been funded by the First Union National Bank of North Carolina.
